quests.title: RBT on Blues Point
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. There's a breath test set up on Blues Point since peak hour. You will see what I mean the second you get there. My brother-in-law needs the ute at the far end of Milsons Point without a conversation. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: get past the breath test on Blues Point
then meet the ute at the far end

quests.title: Rent Money, the Kirribilli markets
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. I'm forty-five short on the the Kirribilli markets rent and the agent doesn't take stories. I am aware how that sounds. Make it somewhere in Milsons Point by eleven; I'm not fussy how. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: earn forty-five somewhere in Milsons Point

quests.title: The the Kirribilli markets Camera
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. A new speed camera near the Kirribilli markets has fined half of Milsons Point since Wednesday. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Photograph it for the appeal, then prove the train to Ashfield is faster anyway. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: photograph the camera near the Kirribilli markets
then take the train instead, to Ashfield

quests.title: Seven a.m. At the Kirribilli markets
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. The site at the Kirribilli markets starts its jackhammer at half four on a Anzac Day, which is illegal and loud. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. Photograph it running and have a word with the Milsons Point foreman. Be polite about it. It costs nothing.

steps.label: photograph the noise from the Kirribilli markets
and have a word with the foreman

quests.title: The Miller Street Fence
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. My neighbour at Miller Street says the tree is on my side and the fence says otherwise. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Look at it Melbourne Cup day with Milsons Point eyes and tell me the truth. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: go and look at the fence at Miller Street
photograph the tree over it
tell me whose side it's on

quests.title: The Length of the Greenwood
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. I haven't walked the Greenwood end to end since the light rail came to Milsons Point. This is the third time I have had this conversation. Do it Monday for me and photograph what's at the far end now. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: walk the length of the Greenwood
to the far end
photograph what's there now

quests.title: Meat Tray at the Greenwood
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. The the Greenwood raffle is thirty-five short of a meat tray and the draw is at first thing. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Find it in Milsons Point and put it in the tin. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: raise thirty-five for the meat tray
and drop it at the Greenwood

quests.title: Race Four, Luna Park
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. There's a horse in race four at bin night that a bloke at Luna Park swears by. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. Turn it into fifty-five somewhere in Milsons Point and tell me if it came in. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: turn the tip into fifty-five
tell me if it came in

quests.title: The Luna Park Float
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. The till at Luna Park opens Monday with an empty float because somebody took it to the pub. I have rung the number on the letter four times. Sixty before the first Milsons Point customer, and I'll never say who. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: clear sixty for the Luna Park float
hand it over at the counter

quests.title: Something From Luna Park
quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. The stall at Luna Park has run out and the customers keep coming. It started small, the way these things do. Find something round Milsons Point that'll do before the first thing rush. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: pick something up near Luna Park
bring it to the stall
